x: The ever-dependable Mike Webb and Will Cockerall closed in the team with Saul Armanini showing once again that he'll soon be helping reduce our points score.

Phil Carstairs often seems to turn in a good 'Southern' and this one was no exception, while Italian Saul Armanini, in his first ever scoring race for the Bels, finished much further up the field than we anticipated.
The final circuit saw Will Cockerell come charging through, displacing Saul Armanini as sixth man and all but getting the best of Phil Carstairs as well.
Will Cockerell scored for us for the first time and Italian Saul Armanini should be well pleased with his first run in Belgrave colours – he will be eligible to score for us come the new year.
